QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] To Pantheon
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've decided to join Heliseum Reclamation HQ, you need to talk to #bGen#k again.
QuestInfo.1: As soon as Gen hears you're going to join up, he gives you the #bD-03 Transmitter#k and claims it'll be useful. Now it's time to talk to #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k.
QuestInfo.2: You spoke with Beldar about joining Heliseum Reclamation HQ.

0.0: I see you're determined. All right, I'll contact the Heliseum branch and have them get the process started.\r\n
0.1: Now, follow this path to meet #bBeldar#k, leader of the #bPantheon#k council. Oh, and take the #bTransmitter#k with you.\r\n

yes.0: If you run into trouble at the Heliseum Secret Merchant Meet-Up, use this, and someone will help you out.\r\n
yes.1: Now I'm gonna tell you this one more time. Never reveal your identity, not even to Reclamation HQ. We don't know who's on our side.\r\n
yes.2: That's all I've got for now. Get yourself to Pantheon.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

0.msg: #b(You mention the rumors and state your intention to join Heliseum Reclamation HQ.)#k\r\n

1.msg: Ah, the famed Apostle of Justice here to help Reclamation HQ. And appearing so...humble, too.

0.msg: #b(They seem to call you that with an awful lot of sarcasm... But as long as you can join Reclamation HQ...)#k\r\n

1.msg: Before you officially join, let me fill you in on what's going on.

2.msg: This could take a while. Why don't you talk to me later?

0.msg: That's all I've got for now. Get yourself to Pantheon.\r\n
